attr.title: Animal Crossing (Nookery)
attr.desc: Nookery is a native PC port of Animal Crossing for the GameCube, built on the ac-decomp decompilation. Move into a village of animals, pay off your house, fish, catch bugs and play the NES games.
attr.inst: Place your Animal Crossing (GAFE01, USA Rev 0) disc image (.rvz, .iso, .gcm or .ciso) in ports/nookery.
